paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Comparison of trainable parameters between Ex1 and Ex2 in Embedding and LM Head training.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of trainable parameters between two experiments, labeled “Ex1” and “Ex2,” during embedding and language model head training. The horizontal axis, representing the categories, lists the experiment names “Ex1” and “Ex2” in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, indicating the number of trainable parameters, ranges from 0 to 100, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced every 10 units. The value axis is labeled “Trainable (%)” and ranges from 3.41 to 98.71, with values expressed as percentages. The bar corresponding to “Ex1” is light purple and has a value of 3.41, while the bar for “Ex2” is light blue and has a value of 98.71. The total height of the “Frozen (%)” bar is 1.29, and the total height of the “Trainable (%)” bar is 96.59.
